language_task: Put the spoon in the drawer.
outcome_evidence: The spoon is initially on the tabletop (frame 0, image and left_ego_image). The robot closes its fingers around it and lifts it clear of the table (frames 58–83, wrist_image and left_ego_image), then carries it to the open drawer. At frames 141–160, wrist_image shows the released spoon resting inside the drawer while the open gripper withdraws. The robot retreats empty through frame 183; no failed acquisition or unintended side effect is visible.
